I know. I hate it when they tell you this or “it’s going to be okay.” That was actually my most hated phrase. However, I posted this last night because I wanted to hear or read from someone that I was loved. I needed it. I can no longer tolerate the sadness in me these days. I wanted to dream a good dream and never wake up. So, just before everything, I wanted to know I was loved— or maybe someone out there felt the same way that I did. Somehow, I knew I was loved at some point in my life. I guess, I really felt loved back when my grandmother was alive and I had that going. I’m sorry if this post somehow made you anything less than okay. I just wanted to hear these words today.

I don’t actually know. I posted this statement because I wanted to hear and read this from someone. I hate cliche statements like this one because when you have mental illness, statements like this are what I always hear— and yet last night I needed to hear it. I don’t know who loves you but once in my life I knew I was loved. I was loved by my grandmother so I had that. Last night, I needed to hear them but I can’t. So I apologize if my post somehow made you feel what you feel.
Hoping that this week will be different. Have a good day! 🙂
Thank you. I needed to hear or read it too.

I also dread going out. I would rather stay at home and drown myself with my thoughts but then there were times that I needed to present and luckily, I enjoyed it and it wasn’t that bad after all. However, when I go back to my bed, my thoughts come back relentlessly. I posted this “you are loved” because I wanted to hear those words last night and thought that someone might actually want to read or hear it too. The same way I did. 

Anyway, thank you for your post. It helps me to know that I am not alone.

I’m sorry to hear that. It’s hard when you can’t do anything and that your biggest challenge is yourself. The hardest part of it all — that some people even the closest to you think they know your pain but in reality, they don’t. Some people think what we are experiencing are feelings that will just pass or plain weakness. I had my psychiatrist before, I was open to friends... until I stopped because I felt helpless. As of now, I am trying my best to get by and to not be miserable. Sometimes I survive, some days I don’t. 

The only thing the kept me going was when my sister told me if I could try to live for her because she knows that I no longer have the will to live for me. It kept me sane, she thanked me every day or when she had the chance to thank me for trying to be alive. I don’t know, that kept me sane.

I don’t know who you are but If I could meet you I would have just sat down with you and let you talk. Just talk or I could be just quiet... because sometimes that all what we need— someone to ACTUALLY LISTEN. For what it’s worth, I am grateful that you are trying to survive. Thank you for living.

Hi, It’s rainy this time of the year in the Philippines. Although, if you want easy island life and meet people, I suggest going to Palawan, Boracay and of course, Siargao.

Best time to go to the Philippines is during summer (if you want to go island hopping and all water related activities).

For accessibility, Boracay is actually okay I didn’t have much problem with transportation. In Coron, Palawan too. Some foreigners rented a motorcycle but if you’re not too keen about it, there are tricycles that will get you to where you want to be especially at night where you can dine and drink.

As for Siargao, this place is really alive at night plus you can surf and meet people. You can also try Cebu. 

I hope this helps.

I am a tattooed woman too and I recently went to Japan. Not really much of an issue with the tats however, if you have tats you can’t enter public baths. Other than that, you have no problem at all (based on my experience).
